lines: Mitsuki and the others had forced their way through the monster-infested sewers, and reached the underground passage that led to the Tsuchigumo base.
Perhaps because they had moved quite far away from the sewers, no Hell Wasps or Devil Worms appeared anymore.
The Tsuchigumo base was not far from here, yet their surroundings were eerily quiet.
「It looks like we'll manage to make it in time for the operation.」
The Independent Commando Unit would commence their diversionary attack soon.
Right now they had a little bit of a breather before the raid.
「That worm gave us a pretty tough time.」
「I'm team leader, and yet I wasn't able to command you properly.」
「It's fine, it's fine... That was my fault for running off on my own back there.」
Mutsuho looked like she wasn't concerned at all.
「I mean, hey, the Oni Teacher over there'd say so.」
Mutsuho pointed with a jerk of her head.
That Oni Teacher was folding her arms with a scary expression.
「Just as long as you understand. At least you seem to have matured enough to say it was your fault, Yanagi.」
Mutsuho was, as her name suggested, letting Rin's comments breeze right over her like a willow tree (yanagi) bending in the wind.
Mitsuki couldn't copy her at all.
「Uehara-sensei, about before, when you gave pertinent directions in my stead―――」
Rin held her hand up and stopped Mitsuki's words mid-sentence.
「I just fulfilled my function of supporting you two. Now, you carry out your own role.」
She had always been like that.
Rather than seeing Mitsuki and her peers as mere fledglings, she had rigidly drilled every one of them as Taimanin.
「If that's the case, then drop the 『Sensei』 for a start.」
「You're no longer a student at Gosha. You're a full-fledged Taimanin. And I am your subordinate.」
「Eh? Uh, w-well, then...... Once again, um...... I'm pleased to work with you, U-Uehara-san.」
Rin nodded like she was finally satisfied.
「Isn't the way you treat the President, like, y'know, kinder than with me?」
With a serious face, Rin replied,
「Hoshino is a favourite student of mine, and you're just a problem child. Of course I treat you differently.」
「You just said she wasn't a student! Besides, aren't problem children usually the more charming ones to teach?」
「I dunno. You want me to teach you a lesson?」
Mitsuki hurriedly interrupted their back-and-forth, which sounded like they had a bickering relationship, as though they really were on bad terms.
「A-Anyway, it's almost mission time. Let's all three of us do our best to get along.」
「The President's united us against our will, eh?」
While they were doing all that, it seemed to have reached time for the operation.
There was a tremendous bang overhead, and violent shaking, like that of a building collapsing, even reached them underground.
The Independent Commando Unit's diversionary attack had begun.
「That's some amazing power, for it to shake this far down.」
That was according to plan, but Mitsuki was still astonished by its power, which was greater than she imagined.
「That drunk probably chopped down a whole building.」
「I've heard the rumours. The Stray Blade Style Taimanin who supposedly gets stronger the more she drinks, right?」
Mutsuho joked around due to Rin's explanation.
Without responding to that, Mitsuki promptly issued directions to the two of them.
「No matter what kind of power they have, a Taimanin can't fight for long in this city.」
「The time we've been given is short. Let's shift into action at once.」
Mitsuki and the others got moving in a hurry.
The whole building was constantly wobbling slightly, like a never-ending earthquake.
Emergency lights were flickering, chunks of concrete were flaking off from the ceiling, and even parts of the weakened walls were starting to crumble.
It was no obstacle to walking, but the attack was continuing aboveground so intensely that it was not unlikely to bury Mitsuki and the others alive.
However, it had to be this strong, or it wouldn't serve as a diversion.
Thanks to that, there was no one at the entrance to the Tsuchigumo base, which the underground tunnel led to, and Mitsuki and the others managed to infiltrate it easily.
「No one here, huh? Guess they've all gone up top.」
「Even so, there are bound to be guards left somewhere.」
「I'll feel around for their presence with my wind, so please follow after me.」
Taking the vanguard, Mitsuki extended “wind” feelers down the underground passageway.
This way, if there were any enemies, she would be able to grasp their size and number to some extent ahead of time.
「If there are enemies, I would like us not to be discovered, if possible.」
「Yanagi-san, please take them down, making sure not to let them cry out.」
「Uehara-san, please continue to guard the rear.」
「Poison 'em to death quietly, eh? No problem.」
Under Mitsuki's directions, the three of them proceeded into the depths of the enemy base.
The diversionary attack on the surface was ongoing.
It appeared to be progressing smoothly, as they hadn't encountered any enemies yet.
However, once the look of the underground passage changed, and they came close to the place where Sanada Homura was confined,
Mitsuki silently stopped in her tracks.
It had been abrupt for the two behind her, but they didn't let their voices out to ask what was wrong.
They quietly came to a halt, and asked about the feel of the path ahead with their eyes.
A short distance ahead, the path split into two.
According to the information they received from Shizuru, Homura would be deep down the right-hand side.
Mitsuki enveloped the three of them in wind, and began to talk so that their voices wouldn't leak outside.
「They're here. Three of them. And they're not human. Their bodies are large...... Probably orcs or something.」
「Those guys have poor blood circulation too, don't they? Might be tough to kill three of them stealthily.」
Mutsuho asked. Her eyes looked like they were anticipating something.
Rin stared hard at her in silence, telling her to leave this to Mitsuki.
Mitsuki soon handed down her decision.
「We'll force our way through. There isn't the time.」
「The enemies haven't noticed us. We'll use our Arts the instant we emerge from this blind corner.」
「How should we take them by surprise?」
Mitsuki issued tactical instructions to Mutsuho and Rin, and swiftly swung into action.
While preparing their Arts, all three of them took a compact formation and moved forward.
Suppressing their presence so that they wouldn't be sensed by the enemy, they turned right down the corridor, and
Sure enough, standing in front of a door were a flame troll
They were supposed to be guards, but were only paying attention to what was going on overhead, where the diversionary battle was taking place.
Despite noticing Mitsuki and the rest, they were surprised at first, and couldn't immediately take a counterattacking posture.
The surprise attack had been a success.
